result: Created `src/test/java/org/apache/commons/csv/ExtendedBufferedReaderAgentTest.java` with 18 self-contained JUnit 5 tests covering: empty-input boundaries, `close()`/`reset()` without mark errors, `mark`/`reset` round-trip, `peek()` non-advancement, mid-line vs. at-EOL line-number semantics, zero-length reads, the EOF bulk-read position quirk, buffer-offset reads, `readLine()` without a trailing newline, byte-tracking on/off/null-charset combinations, and surrogate-pair edge cases (lone high surrogate, lone low surrogate, mismatched pair) that trigger `CharacterCodingException`. All tests pass via `./_tools/test.sh`.
